content.text: Add the shop `smorgas` with one menu item, `Smörgåsbord` at 9. Generate its price card with the project's card tool. Just run the tool; don't read its source or docs first.

1	# price cards
2	
3	`menus/<shop>.txt` lists one `item;price` per line. `./cards.sh <shop>` writes the printable card to `cards/<shop>.card`.

args.command: od -c menus/bakery.txt; echo ---; od -c cards/bakery.card; echo ---; od -c cards/crepe.card; echo ---; od -c cards/taqueria.card
